missing_rule: Missing private/original bytes remain MISSING/PARTIAL. No metadata→AVAILABLE or formal acceptance.
no_hash_cycle: Registry aggregate raw hash is provenance only for exported rows. Resolver and Unit hashes never re-enter frozen row payloads, literal schemas or body catalog semantic payload; if relevant source/model changes, invalidate and freeze a new source revision.

profile_catalog_lookup.rule: Exact finite profile_id and source_epoch; every permission, referenced revision, snapshot/history membership and capture/schema/bytes check still required. Missing or historical profile never relabeled current. Unknown profile is UNSUPPORTED.
